items.name: Amazon/AWS sells 75% of two JVs holding 13 powered-shell data centers (~647 MW) to Blackstone's BXDC for ~USD 5bn at a 7.0% initial cap rate; 12/32-year triple-net leaseback; AWS keeps 25%; ~USD 2.5bn non-recourse JV debt - a principal recycling data-center assets off balance sheet
items.headline: Blackstone Digital Infrastructure Trust 8-K Ex.99.1 / Amazon Sold $5 Billion of Data Centers at a '7% Cap Rate'
items.claim: BXDC 'today announced that it has signed a definitive agreement' (16 Nov) for a 75% majority interest in two JVs with AWS valued at about USD 5bn with an 'initial capitalization rate of 7.0%'; the JVs own 13 newly built powered shells across two AWS campuses, AWS leases back 100% triple-net for 12 years initial / 32 fully extended and keeps 25%; close expected Q4 2026. TIKR: northern Indiana and Mississippi, 2.75%/yr escalators guaranteed by Amazon.com, BXDC contributes ~USD 1.9bn and the JVs borrow ~USD 2.5bn non-recourse; Chanos: 'at a 7% cap rate... all materially lower than where they trade today'. 456X: ~647 MW.
items.source: BXDC Form 8-K Ex.99.1 16 Nov (sec.gov); TIKR via Yahoo 17 Nov 06:33Z; 456X 16 Nov
items.note: Neither a pulled deal nor a capex cut: a registered principal monetising shells at a 7% cap (vs DLR ~4.4% implied) to fund the buildout - the orchestrator decides whether off-balance-sheet funding by a principal is a capex-cycle event. Also recorded as a calendar deal. TIKR dates the agreement 11 Nov vs the release's 16 Nov (SEC date used).

items.name: 456X (single source): Broadcom/Anthropic 700 MW TPU deployment pushed from 2027 to 2028 on construction and power permitting; Broadcom 2026-2030 custom-ASIC revenue forecast cut 11% (research)
items.headline: 456X Semi-AI Evening Brief - November 16, 2026
items.claim: The 456X evening brief dated 16 Nov reports that a 700 MW Anthropic TPU deployment through Broadcom has been pushed from 2027 to 2028 because of construction and power permitting, and that Broadcom's 2026-2030 custom ASIC revenue forecast was cut 11% (research source not named in the summary read).
items.note: Single-source and the underlying research/report is not identified; mlq.ai's Google/Anthropic buildout piece (client_error) was the only other candidate carrier. Against the 2 Sep management plan (1 GW 2026 / 5 GW 2027 / 10 GW 2028) a 700 MW slip is ~14% of the 2027 tranche. Treat as a lead to verify, not a confirmed deferral.
